# List of Figures, Tables, and Apps

A consolidated index of every numbered figure and table in the book. Click any entry to jump to it in context.

## Shinylive Apps

The simulation apps have their own archive: [Shinylive Apps for Sampling Survey](../shinylives_sampling/index.html){target="_blank"}.

## List of Figures

### Introduction to Sampling Survey

* @fig-target-sampled — Target population, sampling frame population and sampled population
* @fig-intro-srs — A simple random sample
* @fig-intro-stratified — A stratified random sample
* @fig-intro-cluster — A cluster sample
* @fig-intro-ratio — Ratio estimation: an SRS, the fitted line and the predicted values
* @fig-intro-ups — Unequal probability sampling with probabilities roughly proportional to y
* @fig-intro-sampdist — Sampling distribution of the sample mean under an unequal-probability design
* @fig-archers — Unbiased, precise and accurate estimators as archers

### Data Analysis with R

* @fig-agpop-acres92-hist — Histogram of 1992 farm acreage
* @fig-agpop-acres-scatter — 1992 vs. 1987 farm acreage, with the 1:1 line
* @fig-agpop-scatter-highres — The saved high-resolution PNG, re-inserted
* @fig-log-acres-hist — Distribution of log(acres92): histogram with empirical density and normal fit

### Simple Random Sampling

* @fig-srs-design — A simple random sample from a synthetic population
* @fig-agsrs-acres92-hist — Farm acreage in 1992 for the SRS of 300 counties, with mean and median
* @fig-srs-simulation-distribution — Population distribution and sampling distribution of the SRS sample mean over 5000 repeated samples (n = 300)
* @fig-srs-coverage-intervals — First 100 simulated 95% confidence intervals for the SRS sample mean, with coverage failures highlighted

### strata

* @fig-strata-pop — A stratified random sample from a synthetic population
* @fig-caribou-strata — The six caribou strata and their sampled units
* @fig-ssb-ssw — Prediction by the overall mean (SSTO) vs. by the stratum means (SSW)
* @fig-r2-compare — Strata with large vs. small $R^2$
* @fig-p1mp — The variance $p(1-p)$ of a 0/1 variable
* @fig-auxiliary — Strata formed by cutting an auxiliary variable
* @fig-agpop-region-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by region stratum
* @fig-agpop-region-compare-boxplot — Sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (region strata, 2000 simulations)
* @fig-agpop-acres82-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by acres82 quantile stratum
* @fig-agpop-acres82-compare-boxplot — Sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (acres82 strata, 2000 simulations)

### ratio

* @fig-ratio-concept — Illustration of the benefits of ratio estimation
* @fig-france-toy — The toy France example with the ratio line and residuals
* @fig-agsrs-acres8792 — 1992 vs. 1987 farm acreage for the SRS of 300 counties, with the ratio line
* @fig-ratio-vs-reg — Data suited to ratio estimation versus regression estimation
* @fig-reg-concept — Illustration of the benefits of regression estimation
* @fig-poststrat-concept — Illustration of the benefits of post-stratification
* @fig-ml-concept — A prediction estimator with a flexible (loess) model
* @fig-cherry-volume-diameter — Cherry tree volume vs. diameter
* @fig-cherry-ratio-fit — Cherry tree volume vs. diameter with the fitted ratio line
* @fig-agpop-acres8792-ratio-line — 1992 vs. 1987 county acreage with the true ratio line
* @fig-agpop-ratio-simulation-boxplot — Estimator variance under repeated sampling: SRS vs. ratio estimator (2000 simulations)
* @fig-cherry-regression-fit — Cherry tree volume vs. diameter with the fitted regression line
* @fig-deadtrees-regression-fit — Field counts vs. photo counts of dead trees with the fitted regression line

### cluster

* @fig-cluster-design — A two-stage cluster sample from a synthetic population
* @fig-cluster-vs-strat — Stratified sampling versus one-stage cluster sampling on the same population
* @fig-cluster-cells — Notation for cluster sampling: cells y_ij, psu totals t_i and sizes M_i
* @fig-cluster-cells-sample — A two-stage cluster sample in the cell notation
* @fig-cluster-r2 — Large versus small adjusted R² between clusters
* @fig-cluster-ratio — Cluster totals against cluster sizes, with the ratio line
* @fig-coots-volume — Coot egg volumes by clutch

### ups

* @fig-statepop-phys-vs-popn — Physicians vs. population (log-log scale), sample of U.S. counties
* @fig-upswr-sim-comparison — Estimator distribution: naive SRS vs. SRS ratio vs. SRS regression vs. UPSWR (2000 simulations)
